name: lever2-forum
description: SHADOW-ONLY forum lever (MA-3, 2026-11-05): more and better buyer posts plus fair votes. Logic in r3lib/forum_lever2.py; switch config.FORUM_LEVER2 = False. Not wired into forum_r3.py; nothing live reads it.
notes: The twin has no model of forum posts or votes: shop metrics are unchanged by construction. The gate runs a deterministic dry run (read-only memory.sqlite, no send, no LLM or decision-model call) and reports ESTIMATED when its checks pass.
Buyer effect is an ESTIMATE: board buyer ALL = 0.5 pct(surplus) + 0.3 pct(forum) + 0.1 pct(deals) + 0.1 pct(posts); only posts move, others keep their last-24 h post rate.
Hours left is not in our data; [구매 기록] uses purchases.use_within_hours, labelled 사용 기한 조건.
Rollback within 2 h of going live: our dislikes per post > 0.8, any hidden post, or any HTTP 429. The current market-wide dislike wave (~1.0-1.2 per buyer post) would trip the 0.8 rule today.

topics.purchase: [구매 기록] our paid purchase: price vs list, grade and claim, use-within hours, seller, ledger #
topics.category: [카테고리 시세] category price/list quartiles and top SKU over 3 h
topics.trend: [가격 동향] category median price/list now vs the 3 h before

uniqueness.subject: new ledger # or new category per topic within REPORT_DEDUPE_H

votes.plus_one: accurate (refs in our ledger, amounts match, quoted in text) and useful
